name: Memoria v0.4.8
body:
## English

### Theme: fix the P1 defect disclosed by 0.4.7, and deliver the knowledge-graph research

#### 1. P1 fixed: preview-area multi-line paste kept only the first line
**The root cause was a race, proven by trace rather than guessed:**
```
insertText(line0) ret=True   cursor off 19->30
splitParagraph()  ret=True   cursor off=30  (new caret NOT restored yet:
                                            restoreCursor runs async inside repaintPreview().then)
insertText(line1) ret=False  <-- caller never checked the return value, so the line was silently lost
splitParagraph()  ret=False
insertText(line2) ret=False
```
The worst part was not "two lines went missing" — it was that **the user was told the paste succeeded**.

Fix: the paragraph-split promise is stored as `_pendingStructural` and exposed as
`whenStructuralIdle()`; multi-line paste **awaits it after each split** before inserting the next line;
**every insertion's return value is checked**; any failure raises `setStatusError` plus `console.error`
(failures are visible, never swallowed); success is only reported after all lines land.

Real-machine OS-level injection: before, **10/10 runs kept only the first line**; after,
**10/10 kept all three** with caret pixel delta x = y = 0 across all ten runs. The source-area control
stayed 10/10 unchanged. The selection matrix restored its assertion — `knownIssues` marked
`resolved: true` while **keeping the case** for traceability — for **159/159 passing, 0 skipped**.

#### 2. Knowledge-graph research, three phases (research only, no code changed)

**Headline finding: the team's own diagnosis was half wrong.**
"no relation types / no weights" does **not** hold at the mechanism layer: `EDGE_TYPES` already has
`{contain, reference, extend}` and `_DEFAULT_RELEVANCE` already has a weight gradient `{0.9, 0.7, 0.6}`.
It holds completely at the **data layer**: in a real knowledge base, **479 of 479 links carry
`edge_type = "reference"` and 479 of 479 carry `relevance = None`**.
So the fix is **not "add types" — it is "make the types that already exist actually get used"**.

**Three semantic-collapse points, each with file:line:**
1. `normalize_link_edge_type()` silently falls back to `reference` for any unknown value.
2. `WIKILINK_HINT_ALIASES` aliases both `prerequisite` and `analogy` to `reference`, so semantics that
   had already been distinguished are **permanently lost**. Only 6 fragment hints survive in the whole
   repository and all of them are inside `kb-spec.zh-CN.md`, so **nothing in real content is recoverable**.
3. The agent-facing tool surface offers only two options, defaulting to `reference`, and `contain` is
   explicitly forbidden from manual use.

**The hairball root cause requires two separate paths** (measured across four knowledge bases):
| KB | nodes | contain | reference share | leaf ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AAA_Vocab | 133 | 0 | **100%** | **2.3%** |
| Administrative-law | 49 | 21 | 52% | 35% |
| examples | 55 | 28 | 53% | 35% |
So "100% reference" is **a special case of AAA_Vocab** (one file equals one knowledge point), **not a
global baseline** — the Lead's original baseline was corrected. Multi-KP bases are structurally healthy
and merely lack rendering; vocab-style bases are flat at the data layer. Links themselves are
**tree-shaped** (five bases: 100% single-target), so the hairball is **a tree being drawn as a net**.

**High-value side finding: the existing "grouping" feature is broken for vocab-style bases.**
`graph-groups.js:83-101` groups by Union-Find connected components; on AAA_Vocab there are only
**2 components and the largest holds 132 of 133 nodes**, so grouping produces one giant group and
**grouping effectively does not happen**. This explains why the feature exists yet users never feel it —
structurally identical to 0.4.7's "attachments born dead" and "compaction never observed".

**Decisions taken:** D1 four relation types (new ones must have a derivation mechanism, otherwise nobody
fills them in); D2 cross-domain edges allowed but filtered by default, existing edges never deleted,
domain proxy v0 = first path segment (labelled heuristic); D3 fallback must leave a machine-readable
trail; **D4 release 0.5 ships only domain overview + ego network** (tree layout and the 6x6 domain
matrix deferred — the data does not support them being the pain fix); D5 default stays `force`, with a
hairball-state hint for discoverability; acceptance metrics **pre-registered and split per base** to
prevent "change the metric when you miss it", with the core metric being **largest-group share
99.2% -> under 40%**; **zero data migration** since every change is read-side.

#### Known debts (registered, not falsely closed)
The same class of race still exists for Enter followed immediately by typing; the research was never
externally benchmarked (deliberate and documented); 30 ledger items still lack item-level real-machine
acceptance; `AG21` still lacks a real-model turn.

## Cost (Agent compute)

- **Magnitude**: roughly **CNY 300-800** (estimate; not itemised).
- **Accounting basis**: **v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 counted as one block.** These three releases cannot be split
  per-version honestly: they share one continuous architecture effort, one acceptance chain, and one
  team session. Token-level accounting was never recorded, so the figure is estimated from session
  rounds and team size rather than metered.
- **Cost structure (one line)**: most of the spend went to **round-after-round real-machine
  verification and root-cause attribution**, not to writing code. In particular, chasing three
  separate "false completion" cases (dead code / born-dead wiring / broken measurement instrument)
  consumed the majority of it.

## Memoria v0.4.8 —— 补 0.4.7 披露的缺陷 + 知识图谱调研

本版两件：修掉 0.4.7 明确披露的 **P1 产品缺陷**，以及交付知识图谱的**三阶段调研**（为 0.5 定范围）。

---

## 一、修复 P1：预览区折叠光标多行粘贴只保留首行

**这是 0.4.7 已知问题里明确披露的那个缺陷。**

### 症状
预览区（折叠光标）处 Ctrl+V 粘贴 3 行 ⇒ **只保留第 1 行**、光标丢失。
**最坏的不是"少粘两行"，是"用户以为粘贴成功了"** —— 最后仍提示「已粘贴」。

### 根因（实测 trace，不是猜测）
```
insertText(line0) ret=True   cursor off 19→30
splitParagraph()  ret=True   cursor off=30（未恢复新光标 — restoreCursor 在 repaintPreview().then 里异步）
insertText(line1) ret=False  ← 调用方未查返回值 ⇒ 静默丢
splitParagraph()  ret=False
insertText(line2) ret=False
```
⇒ **竞态**：拆段的光标恢复是**异步**的，循环**同步**继续插下一行 ⇒ 旧 `cursorAST` 下插入失败；
且**返回值被丢弃**、最后仍提示成功。

### 修复
- 拆段 promise 存为 `_pendingStructural`，暴露 `whenStructuralIdle()`
- 多行粘贴**每拆一段 `await` 再插下一行**
- **逐步检查返回值**；任一失败 ⇒ `console.error` + `setStatusError`（**失败可见，不再静默吞掉**）
- 成功才提示「已粘贴」

### 验证（真机 + 矩阵双口径）
| 口径 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 真机 OS 级注入（预览区） | **10/10 只留第 1 行** | **10/10 三行全保留** |
| caret 像素断言 | — | **10/10 Δx=Δy=0** |
| 源码区对照 | 10/10 三行 | **10/10 三行（不变）** |
| 选区矩阵 | 该用例被 skip | **159/159 PASS，跳过 0** |

矩阵恢复断言：`knownIssues` 标 `resolved: true`（**保留用例不删**，历史可追溯）。

---

## 二、知识图谱三阶段调研（纯调研，不改代码）

### 最重要的一条：推翻了「无关系类型 / 无权重」的判断
**机制层早就有了** —— `EDGE_TYPES={contain, reference, extend}`，权重梯度 `{0.9, 0.7, 0.6}`。
**但数据层全都没有** —— 真实库 479 条 link 的 `edge_type` **100% 是 `reference`**、`relevance` **100% 是 `None`**。

⇒ **解法不是"加类型"，是"让已有的类型真的被用上"。**

### 三段语义塌缩链（语义具体在哪丢的，全 file:line）
1. `normalize_link_edge_type()` 对未知值**一律静默回落 reference**
2. `WIKILINK_HINT_ALIASES` 把 `prerequisite` / `analogy` **全部 alias 成 reference**
   ← **本已区分的语义在此永久丢失**（源文件仅规范文档残留 6 处提示，真实内容无可恢复信息）
3. 给 agent 的选项只有 2 个且默认 reference，`contain` 还禁手标

### 毛球根因：必须分两条路径（多库实测）
| 库 | 节点 | contain | reference 占比 | 叶子比例 | 判断 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **AAA_Vocab** | 133 | **0** | **100%** | **2.3%** | 数据平级（1 文件 1 KP，contain 无从产生） |
| 行政法 | 49 | **21** | 52% | **35%** | 结构健康，缺**渲染** |
| examples | 55 | **28** | 53% | **35%** | 同上 |
| showcase | 35 | 0 | 85% | 12% | — |

⇒ **「100% reference」只是 AAA_Vocab 的特例，不能当全局基线。**
⇒ 且 link 本身是**树状**（5 库 100% 单目标）⇒ **毛球是「树被画成了网」**。

### 高价值副发现：现有「分组」功能对词典型库失效
```
graph-groups.js:83-101  computeGraphGroups() 用 Union-Find 连通分量（每条边 union）
AAA_Vocab 实测：连通分量 2 个，最大分量 132/133
⇒ 分组产出 1 个含 132 点的巨型组 ⇒ 分组等于没分
⇒ 这解释了「分组功能存在但用户感受不到」
```
**与 0.4.7 的三个问题同构**：附件出生即死 / 压缩从未被观测 / 分组对词典型库失效。

### 已裁方案（0.5 范围）
```
D1 本体 4 类：contain(自动) / reference(兜底降权) / prerequisite / exemplify
   ← 新增 2 类必须有【推导机制】，不能只是"可选 enum 多两个值"
     （证据：479/479 全取默认值 ⇒ 作者不会主动填）
D2 跨域边：允许但【默认过滤】，不删现有边；域代理 v0 = 路径首段（标注启发式）
D3 回落 + 【可机读留痕 warn】（不能只打 console）
D4 0.5 只做 2 项：域概览 + 邻域聚焦 ego network
   树布局 / 6×6 域矩阵 → v1（数据不支持：多 KP 库本健康、词典型库 contain=0 无骨架）
D5 默认 force 不变 + 【毛球态提示】兜底发现性
D6 不补外部对标（真问题是"作者不填类型"，外部本体论回答不了）
```
**验收指标预先登记、分库**（防"达不到就改指标"）：
核心指标 **最大分组占比 99.2%（132/133）→ <40%**（纯数据，不依赖截图或主观）。

**迁移：零数据迁移** —— 都是纯读侧（改渲染/分组），不写 sidecar、不改 schema，
479 links / 454 edges 原样保留，旧视图全保留。

## 造价

- **本版两件事的量级不对等**：P1 修复是 `app.js` +47/−13 的小改动，
  但根因定位（异步光标恢复竞态 + 返回值被丢弃）花了整轮真机 trace；
  调研是三阶段、跨 4 个库实测、两次自查自纠。
- **调研的主要产出不是"方案"，是"推翻了原假设"**：
  从"无类型无权重" → "机制层有、数据层没有"；
  从"全局 100% reference" → "只是 AAA_Vocab 特例"；
  从"分组功能可用" → "对词典型库等于没分"。
- **三个版本连续修的是同一类问题**：0.4.7 修了「附件出生即死」「压缩从未被观测」，
  0.4.8 找到第三个同构的「分组对词典型库失效」。
  **共同形态：功能在代码里存在、在测试里通过、在用户那里从未生效。**

## 造价（Agent 算力）

- **量级**：约 **300–800 元人民币**（估算，非逐项计量）。
- **统计口径**：**v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 合并统计**。这三版无法诚实切分到单版：它们共享同一条连续的
  架构工作线、同一条验收链、同一个团队会话；且 token 级台账从未记录，故按会话轮次与团队规模估算，
  不是计量值。
- **成本结构（一句话）**：主要花在**逐轮真机验证与根因归因**，不是写代码。其中追查三起独立的
  「假完成」（死代码 / 出生即死接线 / 量具盲区）占了大头。
